title: Book Three · Chapter 60: The Dinner He Makes
story:
On Saturday morning, Ronan takes out his tenth letter to Leo.

He adds the new term news and tells Leo about Kai's light. Then he puts the letter and Anna's copied drawing in an envelope. At the post office, he buys a stamp and sends it. Back home, he leaves room on his shelf for another reply.

By afternoon, Mum has a coat spread across the table. One sleeve needs a new lining. Dad is at Mr Sun's place until the usual time.

Ronan comes in from the yard.

“I can make the eggs tonight,” he says.

Mum looks up.

“And the potatoes?”

“Both.”

He has made them with Dad several times. Today he takes the bowl and vegetables into the kitchen himself.

Mum puts the rice on first. Then she returns to the sleeve.

Ronan washes the potatoes and cuts them. He cracks the eggs into a bowl. One small piece of shell follows the second egg.

He looks at it.

“Extra food?” Mum asks from the doorway.

“Not on today's list.”

He takes the shell out. Mum smiles and goes back to her work.

Soon the kitchen smells warm and good. Ronan turns the potatoes and checks the rice. He puts three bowls on the table.

He sets a smaller bowl aside for himself before he takes the dishes out. He has learned that Dad comes home very hungry.

Mum moves her cloth to the chair. She has only a few stitches left, but she lays the needle down.

Dad comes home as Ronan brings out the first dish.

“Who made that?”

“The new cook,” Mum says.

Dad washes his hands and sits down. Ronan brings the eggs and the rice. He stays on his feet until both parents have food.

“You can eat too,” Dad says.

“I'm checking the customers.”

“This one is hungry.”

Ronan sits. He takes a mouthful and waits. The potatoes are soft inside, with brown edges. They taste right.

Dad reaches for a second spoonful. Mum does too.

Ronan stops watching them and starts to eat properly.

“Again next week?” Mum asks.

“I need to check my other plans.”

She raises her eyebrows. Then he grins.

“Yes. The eggs are free on Saturday.”

Dad laughs and takes the last bit from the dish.

After dinner, he carries the pan to the kitchen. Mum finishes the few stitches while Ronan wipes the table.

From the kitchen, Dad begins to hum. He gets one part of the tune wrong. Mum keeps her eyes on the sleeve and hums the right part.

Dad tries again, louder.

Ronan joins with three words he knows. Dad stops and looks through the doorway.

“Those aren't the words.”

“They are now.”

Mum laughs and puts her needle away. Dad goes back to the pan, still humming. Ronan carries the last bowl into the kitchen and joins him at the sink.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

shell＝蛋壳；crack＝敲开；raise one's eyebrows＝挑起眉毛；hum＝哼曲子。

## 理解问题

1. 第十封信里有没有放Anna原来的手稿？Ronan用了哪一张图？
2. 他做饭时遇到了什么小问题？父母怎样实际表达了喜欢这顿饭？

## 读句子

**He takes the shell out.**

拆开看：He / takes / the shell out.

他／取出／那片蛋壳。
